status.description: COMPLETE only when the case is eligible for an automated outcome. Otherwise PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.

consideredRiderRebuttalIds.description: Optional. Rider rebuttal IDs you took into account, e.g. RIDER-RB1. Must appear in your context. A rejected rebuttal is not in your context and must not be cited. An empty list is valid.

consideredDriverRebuttalIds.description: Optional. Driver rebuttal IDs you took into account, e.g. DRIVER-RB1. Must appear in your context. An empty list is valid.

recommendedOutcome.description: The outcome you recommend, chosen from the outcomes listed in your context. Never invent an outcome, and never include an amount.

acceptedRiderClaimIds.description: Verified Rider claim IDs you accept. Must match claim IDs in your context exactly.

acceptedDriverClaimIds.description: Verified Driver claim IDs you accept. Must match claim IDs in your context exactly.

rejectedRiderClaimIds.description: Verified Rider claim IDs you do not accept. A claim may not appear in both an accepted and a rejected list.

rejectedDriverClaimIds.description: Verified Driver claim IDs you do not accept. A claim may not appear in both an accepted and a rejected list.

reasoningSummary.description: A concise explanation for a human reviewer. Not a chain of thought. Must not contain any monetary amount.

evidenceIds.description: Evidence IDs you relied on. Every ID must exist in your context.

policyRuleIds.description: Policy rule IDs you applied. Every ID must exist in your context.

uncertainties.description: What remains unresolved or unproven. State missing evidence here rather than assuming it.

requiresHumanReview.description: True when this case must be decided by a human. Must be true whenever status is PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
